subject.title: Redesign Overview as an operator-first OpenClaw dashboard

question: Should maintainers pursue this contributor branch, the overlapping dashboard PR at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/77774, or a narrower provider-usage extraction as the canonical Overview direction?
rationale: The remaining work is not only a mechanical fix: there are two competing dashboard redesign branches plus unique provider-usage behavior, so a maintainer needs to choose the product path before more repair work is useful.

options.title: Require rebased narrow repair
options.body: Keep this PR open only if the author rebases onto current UI paths, fixes the auth-status blockers, and supplies live provider proof.

options.title: Use the overlapping dashboard PR
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/77774 the dashboard direction and ask this author to extract provider-native usage work into a smaller PR.

options.title: Pause the redesign
options.body: Leave both dashboard redesign branches parked until a maintainer writes a narrower Overview spec.

recommendation.title: Require rebased narrow repair
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open only if the author rebases onto current UI paths, fixes the auth-status blockers, and supplies live provider proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the overlapping maintainer-labeled dashboard redesign branch, making them the clearest product-direction routing candidate.
